specification_compliance: I10 (R2-1, length checked before or after dedup): fixed. addons/intelligence/app/file_matching.py:61-73 now checks each stripped, non-blank tag against TAG_MAX_LENGTH at :65 before the lower() dedup at :67-71. That is the order the core uses at backend/app/routers/internal.py:633-641 (length at :637, setdefault on tag.lower() at :641). For ['İ'*101, 'i̇'*101], both sides now see the second raw tag at 202 code points and reject the filter.

I10, other dimensions re-read for parity: both sides fold with lower(), drop tags that are blank after strip(), count the cap of 20 after dedup, accept the eight kinds plus 'markdown' as 'text' and match kinds exactly with no strip and no case fold (core FileKindParam Literal at drives.py:102-124; addon KINDS/_KIND_ALIASES at file_matching.py:31-34,78-80), dedup kinds before the cap of 8, and use StrictBool for both flags. I found no remaining input that one validator accepts and the other rejects.

R2-2 (core-side parity row): fixed. backend/tests/test_internal_files_matching.py TestRequestCaps.test_fold_sensitive_tags_match_the_addon_validator now holds the same two rows as the addon's INVALID_FILTERS (test_filtered_search_contract.py:176-183), with the same ids.

The fix commit stays inside the planned touch points: the addon gitlink (5d65c9d -> d5795aaf), the addon validator and its contract test, and a backend test. No core production code changed in this round.
potential_unspecified_behavior: The spec does not say whether the 200-character cap applies before or after dedup. Both validators now apply it before dedup, so a long spelling that would be dropped as a duplicate still makes the request fail with 422. This is consistent on both sides but is not written down anywhere.

The r1 needs-human items are still open and this round did not touch them: the filtered-query `loading` no longer waits for semanticLoading, `available:false` now counts as a failure and is not cached, and the modal clears merged rows on a filtered query change.
regression_risks: The parity table is still two hand-copied lists, the addon's INVALID_FILTERS and the core's TestRequestCaps rows. A new rejection rule added on one side only would not be caught unless someone mirrors it by hand.
Moving the addon's length check ahead of dedup only changes which ValueError message is raised for inputs that break both caps. The status is 422 either way, so no response code changes.

I read the files on disk. I did not confirm that the worktree's submodule checkout is exactly d5795aaf.
I did not re-read the addon's scoped channel code in app/search.py or the frontend, because this round did not change them.

trajectory: There have been two fix rounds. In efbe71ff3 the addon's tag-dedup fold changed from casefold() to lower() to match the core. In 463ecfd7c the addon's 200-character length check moved from after dedup to before it, the same order as the core, and the core gained the mirror test rows. Neither round adds a branch, a state or a prediction. Each one removes a difference between the addon and core validators by changing existing code to match the core, and the only additions are test rows. No round repeats something an earlier round added, so the design is not being patched. The second round closes the ordering difference that the r1 verifier noted and that r2 reported as R2-1, and it also closes R2-2.
